official_source.main_description_evidence: Verified indexed main-page description provided by Astra in the task context; no new resource-tab claim.
official_source.supported_intent: Use open Earth, Moon and Mars data to identify and characterize new terrestrial analog candidates and present results through a map, visualization or other tool.

interpretation.new_definition: New candidate relative to a frozen, sourced project baseline within a declared search domain; not a world-first or NASA approval claim.
interpretation.project_minimum: At least one qualified non-baseline candidate from reproducible systematic search; original top-3 acceptance remains separate.
not_claimed_as_nasa_mandates: Apache-2.0 as the only permitted license

existing_gaps.gap: Curated candidates can satisfy the current wording without baseline-relative discovery.
Correct scoring does not establish systematic candidate enumeration or novelty.
Current views need not expose search domain, known/new distinction, uncertainty or coverage evidence.

contract_policy.proposed_sidecar: A separately agreed discovery manifest/GeoJSON linked by existing location_id and profile_id.

requirements.title: Trace user-supplied Resources membership separately from verified target/product use
acceptance_checks: Record the official main/resources URLs and distinguish indexed main-page content from user_provided_page_content membership for all 11 listed resources.
Verify target URLs, archive/product relationships, selected versions and terms separately; do not relabel all existing source-registry products as explicitly listed.
Label project policy/formula/performance/licensing decisions separately from confirmed challenge instructions.
Record the contextual scope of GO Team guidance and do not claim team eligibility without the complete evidence chain.
evidence_required: User-provided Resources content and stable resource registry IDs
GO Team guidance with scope and no eligibility claim

requirements.title: Freeze a sourced known-analog baseline before candidate selection
acceptance_checks: Version/hash the known-analog list with sources and documented geometry uncertainty.
Declare search domain and spatial overlap/separation rules before viewing results.
Uncertain known-site geometry yields unresolved novelty rather than a positive novelty claim.

requirements.title: Systematic candidate generation from real geospatial coverage
acceptance_checks: Derive reproducible grid/windows from real georeferenced source coverage; label AOIs as analysis units.
Keep stable candidate IDs and account for generated/invalid/excluded/eligible candidates.
Document candidate generation parameters and real processed area without overlap double counting.
Candidate selection is not limited to a whitelist of already named analog sites or chosen retrospectively for attractive scores.

requirements.title: Matched-scale frozen-profile screening without selection leakage
acceptance_checks: Apply one profile with compatible quantities, methods, spatial support and effective resolution to the declared ranking cohort.
Calibration is fixed independently of the shortlisted winners; no hidden per-candidate feature masks or clipped values.
Known/new labels do not alter the numerical score.
Missing or incompatible candidates retain explicit exclusion reasons.

requirements.title: Qualified non-baseline candidate and defensible novelty claim
acceptance_checks: At least one qualified candidate comes from systematic search outside the frozen baseline under the declared overlap policy.
Adjacent windows are grouped/filtered by a predetermined spatial rule; they are not advertised as distinct sites to fill top-3.
Each selected candidate has novelty status and supporting evidence; limited-baseline novelty is explicit.
Fewer than three eligible independent results remain fewer than three; original top-3 criterion is not marked complete.

requirements.title: Scientific characterization and uncertainty disclosure
acceptance_checks: Each shortlisted ROI reports matched attributes, source/method/resolution/valid fraction and unmeasured/non-comparable dimensions.
Use available QA/uncertainty information; missing uncertainty is not_quantified, never fabricated error bars.
Report reproducible rank sensitivity to documented justified profile/scale alternatives without calling it a probability or confidence interval.
Topography-only results are described as morphological candidates, not complete environmental analogs or suitable base sites.
evidence_required: Independent extraction cross-check or clearly labeled reproducibility check

requirements.title: Map discovery evidence and distinguish baseline from findings
acceptance_checks: Display real search-domain/candidate AOI geometry and distinct known-baseline/new-candidate/unresolved labels.
Expose target/profile/baseline identity, coverage/exclusions, source URLs and characterization limitations.
A map label/score links to the same exported location ID; no fabricated terrain or unsupported geographic extent.
Offline static artifacts support the map; ground/splat mode is available only when real assets exist.
evidence_required: Network log and local asset manifest

requirements.title: Reproducible discovery demonstration and scoped acceptance
acceptance_checks: Regenerate the same candidate enumeration and shortlist from frozen source/baseline/profile revisions.
Show evidence for both identification and characterization; distinguish benchmark performance from discovery.
Claims about area, novelty, uncertainty and performance reflect measured evidence and declared scope.
Retain all original human PASS/review gates; this addendum and prepared artifacts do not close any requirement.
evidence_required: Final CHAL plus original requirement report
Both explicit human PASS signals for the integrated accepted revision

requirements.title: Trace at least one listed NASA resource through actual product use to the UI
acceptance_checks: At least one NASA challenge_resource_id from the documented Resources membership resolves through a verified relationship to the actual selected product/version/access URL.
The exact raw file has a local path, retrieval evidence and matching SHA-256; supporting documentation is not substituted for scientific data usage.
A declared method derives a feature/artifact, linked to exported location/asset IDs and the fixed profile where applicable.
Actual UI consumption of that derived result is demonstrated; merely citing, downloading or displaying a logo does not satisfy use.
Related external and partner products retain explicit relationship type and actual license; no product is called explicitly listed without evidence.
The evidence chain supports project traceability, not an automatic statement of Global Awards eligibility.
evidence_required: Primary target and resource-to-product relationship record
Reproduction method and derived artifact/feature lineage
Actual UI use evidence tied to exported IDs

loop_mapping.LOOP_0: Prepare discovery/baseline contract and source traceability only; no phase advancement implied.
loop_mapping.LOOP_1: Run a bounded real-data discovery slice alongside current integration.
loop_mapping.LOOP_2: Explore confirmed candidate scenes with split-screen/splat as actual assets permit.
loop_mapping.LOOP_3: Reproduce discovery offline and audit source, novelty and presentation claims.

current_evidence.note: This artifact specifies an acceptance gap; downloaded source files or existing prompts are not discovery evidence.

gate: No implementation PASS and no PHASE_5. Existing paired human Dev_A/Dev_B acceptance remains mandatory.

go_team_guidance.author: Nick-GO-Team
go_team_guidance.context: Different challenge discussion; generally worded GO Team answer.
go_team_guidance.guidance: For Global Awards, use at least one NASA data source included in the challenge Resources; additional NASA/partner Resources are encouraged but optional.
go_team_guidance.application: Require evidence of a listed NASA resource actually used in this project, with verified resource-to-product relation.
